name: proto-blocks/cadco-intro
title: Cadco Intro
description: A statement block: a small eyebrow line, a display heading that can carry a coloured phrase, an optional paragraph of prose, and a call-to-action button. Left-aligned or centred.

heading.label: Heading
heading.default: Built on 30 years of quality, reliability, and foodservice expertise.

body.label: Body
body.default: Cadco doesn't overcomplicate things. We believe in simplicity, durability, and availability for the chefs and culinary pros who want to do more cooking and less troubleshooting. Made in Windstead, Connecticut, Cadco products and equipment are quickly becoming the secret weapon for kitchens around the country.

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.help: Centred also widens the heading's measure, matching the closing statement in the design.
